@common.sentenceJoin.sameAsSourceJustification: Czech joins two complete sentences with one plain space, exactly like English; there is no other separator to write.

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol (ČSN EN 80000-13); Czech uses KiB unchanged, as cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.* and Dolphin cs („512 KiB“) do.

@common.sizeUnit.mebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol (ČSN EN 80000-13); Czech uses MiB unchanged, as cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.* and Dolphin cs („ MiB“) do.

@common.sizeUnit.gibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol; Czech uses GiB unchanged (termbase ruling size-unit-gibibyte; cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.opt.binary).

@common.sizeUnit.tebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol; Czech uses TiB unchanged, in step with KiB/MiB/GiB.

@common.sizeUnit.pebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol; Czech uses PiB unchanged, in step with KiB/MiB/GiB.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol with lowercase k prefix; Czech writes kB unchanged (cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.opt.si „Desítkový SI (kB, MB, GB)“).

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol; Czech writes MB unchanged (macOS cs System Settings „MB“; cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.opt.si).

@common.sizeUnit.gigabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol; Czech writes GB unchanged (cs settings.appearance.fileSizeFormat.opt.si).

@common.sizeUnit.terabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol; Czech writes TB unchanged, in step with kB/MB/GB.

@common.sizeUnit.petabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol; Czech writes PB unchanged, in step with kB/MB/GB.
